about: Models for the generic skirmish's unit kinds (ai3d::skirmish::KINDS), exported from the art studio in rts-engine (art/studio/export_gltf.py --lod low) from these generic studio models: builder vehicles/mcv, generator buildings/power_plant, extractor buildings/silo, factory buildings/heavy_factory, tank vehicles/battle_tank, artillery vehicles/missile_tank.
